framework: SHAPE America National Standards and Grade-Level Outcomes for K-12 Physical Education
subject: Physical Education
attribution: SHAPE America - Society of Health and Physical Educators. National Standards & Grade-Level Outcomes for K-12 Physical Education. Champaign, IL: Human Kinetics, 2014.
textFidelity: PARAPHRASED. The five National Standards are published openly and are reproduced faithfully as cluster names. The grade-level outcomes, however, are published in a copyrighted Human Kinetics volume rather than as a free web resource. Outcome codes here follow SHAPE's documented convention (Standard.Level.Outcome.Grade, where E = elementary, M = middle school, H = high school with Level 1 or Level 2), but the outcome TEXT is a faithful paraphrase written for this prototype, not a verbatim quotation. This file must be reconciled against the published volume before any public-facing use.
note: SHAPE America organizes high school outcomes into Level 1 (the graduation expectation) and Level 2 (beyond graduation expectation) rather than by grade. Physical Education 9 and 10 use Level 1 outcomes; Fitness and Wellness (11) and Lifetime Fitness (12) use Level 2. Standards are split across the paired grades so no grade repeats another's set. SHAPE released revised national standards in 2024; this prototype uses the 2014 edition because its grade-level outcome structure is the one most districts currently report against.
